- **`facts.jsonl`** has the `derived_from` links. Without it I can't tell which facts descend from s0007, so I can't count affected facts, check any of the 10 probe ids, or find the 5 earliest by `at`.
- **`sources.json`** would show how s0007 maps to its uri and which facts cite it directly.
- **`logs/<agent>.jsonl`** has the `read` lists that determine affected agents.
- **`handoffs.jsonl`** has the `carries` lists that determine affected handoffs.

The decisions file lists the `based_on` fact ids for each decision. Without knowing which facts are affected, none of those ids can be marked affected or unaffected, so the decision count is also unknown.
